description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The tags for the virtual node.

description.zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。如果ECI Pod中设置了`dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst`，则使用该配置值为容器提供DNS服务。
支持配置多个IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用半角逗号间隔。
description.en: A client token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 集群的域名。配置后，除了主机的搜索域外，Kubelet会配置所有容器来搜索该域名。
description.en:
The IP address of the DNS server. If the dnsPolicy of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) pod is set to `ClusterFirst`, the pod uses this IP address for the DNS service.
You can specify multiple IP addresses. Use commas (,) to separate the IP addresses.

description.zh:
虚拟节点支持的自定义资源。如果ECI Pod的request中声明了相应的自定义资源，则该Pod会被调度到VNode。
格式为`资源名称=资源数量`，多个资源之间使用半角逗号间隔。
description.en: The domain name of the cluster. Kubelet configures all containers to search for this domain name in addition to the search domain of the host.
The tags of the virtual node.
The name of the virtual node.

The custom resources that the virtual node supports. If an ECI pod requests the custom resources, the pod is scheduled to the virtual node.
The value must be in the `resource_name=resource_count` format. Use commas (,) to separate multiple resources.

descriptions.zh:
##  接口说明
仅支持更新状态为Ready的虚拟节点。
descriptions.en:
## API Operations

You can update only virtual nodes that are in the Ready state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci update-virtual-node --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-node-id vnd-2ze960zkdqrldeaw0000 --virtual-node-name testNode --custom-resources example1.com=100,example2.com=200 --cluster-domain example.com --cluster-dns 100.1.XX.XX --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --tag Value=test Key=name --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci UpdateVirtualNode --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key name --VirtualNodeId 'vnd-2ze960zkdqrldeaw0000' --CustomResources 'example1.com=100,example2.com=200' --ClusterDomain 'example.com' --Tag.1.Value test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterDNS '100.1.XX.XX' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --VirtualNodeName testNode
